Cate-A-Bake Factory Shop operates from Hermanstad, on the corner of Moot and Haarlem Streets, Pretoria, supplying catering and baking ingredients direct to the public at wholesale prices. The factory shop is part of the broader Cate-A-Bake business and focuses on giving home bakers, caterers and small food businesses access to bulk ingredients such as flour and other baking staples without needing a trade account. Being located in the Hermanstad industrial area, within the Old Mutual Industrial Park, gives the shop convenient access for customers collecting bulk orders by vehicle, as well as for nearby catering and food-service operators sourcing ingredients regularly.

The shop maintains an active social media presence to showcase baking tips and new stock arrivals, and welcomes walk-in customers as well as regular trade buyers. As a wholesale-focused outlet rather than a retail bakery, Cate-A-Bake Factory Shop is geared toward value-conscious buyers who want to purchase baking and catering ingredients in larger quantities, making it a practical stop for anyone preparing food at scale in the greater Pretoria area.

Centurion Dental Studio is a dental practice in Wierdapark, Centurion, that has provided professional dental care in the area for more than 51 years. The practice offers a broad range of general and restorative dentistry, including composite (white) fillings, root canal treatment, dental crowns and bridges, and removable full and partial prosthetics. Oral hygiene services cover scaling and polishing, fissure sealants and oral hygiene instruction, while a dedicated paediatric dentistry service aims to create positive, gentle experiences for younger patients from an early age. The practice also provides orthodontic dentistry for repairing, replacing and straightening teeth, dental implants as a permanent option for replacing missing teeth, and cosmetic dentistry including dental veneers through its in-house Aesthetics Studio. Centurion Dental Studio operates its own dental laboratory, allowing certain restorative and prosthetic work to be managed on site.

Serving residents of Wierdapark, Eldoraigne and the surrounding Centurion area, the practice positions itself around family-oriented, full-service dental care, aiming to support patients through all stages of oral health, from childhood prevention to cosmetic and restorative treatment in later life.

City Angels Funeral Services has served the Eersterust community in Pretoria since 1 May 2001, offering a range of funeral-related services to local families. The business specialises in burials, cremations and the transportation of deceased loved ones, alongside funeral cover policies and the supply of tombstones. Its staff present themselves as offering dignified, reliable and professional service, with an emphasis on affordability and support for both funeral arrangements and ongoing funeral policy cover. City Angels Funeral Services describes customer service as central to its approach, aiming to assist grieving families with courteous and expedient service during a difficult time.

Because the business is based in Eersterust, it is positioned to serve this community and the surrounding areas of eastern Pretoria directly, without clients needing to travel far for arrangements, consultations or policy queries. The company presents itself as a long-standing operator in the local funeral services sector, having built its presence in the area over more than two decades.

For those seeking funeral cover, the business indicates it offers competitively priced premiums as part of its policy offerings, in addition to its direct funeral service work such as burials and cremations.

CLC is an authorised financial services provider, holding FSP licence number 26908, operating from Highveld Techno Park in Bronberrik, Pretoria. The company positions itself around providing exceptional service within the short-term insurance industry, and has built its offering on in-house, web-based systems and products that it develops itself rather than relying solely on third-party software. This in-house development approach allows CLC to tailor its systems directly to the needs of the short-term insurance sector it serves.

Operating from a technology park location gives the business convenient access to the wider Pretoria business and insurance community while maintaining its own dedicated office space. As a regulated financial services provider, CLC operates under the compliance framework required of FSP licence holders, including data subject request and complaints resolution processes typical of businesses in the short-term insurance and financial services space.

Clubview Guest House is a guesthouse in Clubview East, Centurion, offering several types of guest accommodation including a Standard Double Room, a Standard Family Room and a Standard Twin/King-size Room. The guest house provides on-site facilities and a meals service for guests, along with a gallery and guest reviews showcased on its own website. Its reservations office is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 18:00, with reduced hours over weekends and public holidays, giving guests a clear window for enquiries and bookings. The guest house has previously run a direct booking offer providing a discount off the standard room rate for guests who book through its own website rather than third-party platforms.

Located in Clubview East, the property is positioned within reach of Centurion's business and retail areas, making it a practical option for both business travellers attending meetings in the area and leisure visitors exploring Centurion. The range of room types, from double rooms to family and twin/king-size configurations, allows the guest house to accommodate couples, families and individual travellers under one roof.

CN Lighting Series is a South African technology company that manufactures locally produced, high quality, ultra-high luminance LED lighting systems for the aviation industry. Its product range includes LED strobe lights for aircraft, LED landing lights for aircraft, and LED strobe lights designed for use on remote-controlled aircraft and drones. For ground infrastructure, the company produces LED airport and runway lighting, LED heliport lights for helipads, and LED obstruction lights used to mark structures that could pose a hazard to aircraft, along with illuminated windsocks. CN Lighting Series also develops PTT control systems and an ATC computer-based control system, extending its offering beyond fixtures into the control technology used to operate aviation lighting installations.

The company describes itself as well established and sustainable, built around guaranteeing service to clients in terms of product delivery, service delivery and general support, with guarantees offered on its products. By manufacturing locally rather than relying solely on imported aviation lighting equipment, CN Lighting Series is positioned to serve airports, heliports and aircraft operators across South Africa with aviation-grade LED lighting and the supporting control systems these installations require.

Designelo Visual Solutions is a visual communications company in Murrayfield, Pretoria, working across signage, printing, branding and design, and advertising. The business creates signage intended to make client brands distinctive and memorable, while its printing services cover materials such as promotional flyers, leaflets, proposals and contracts. Its branding and design work is aimed at elevating a business's recognition and loyalty through both web and offline services, and its advertising offering includes various outdoor advertising platforms intended to increase a client's market share and brand awareness. Dis-Chem Wonderpark Pharmacy is a branch of the Dis-Chem Pharmacies chain, which has operated in South Africa since 1978, located within the Wonderpark Shopping Centre at the corner of Old Brits Road and Heinrich Avenue in Karenpark, Pretoria. The branch offers the retail pharmacy, beauty and health product range typical of Dis-Chem stores, alongside two services highlighted specifically for this location: Click & Collect, allowing customers to order online and collect in-store, and an on-site clinic offering healthcare services beyond standard pharmacy dispensing. The clinic operates its own set of hours separate from the main store and pharmacy trading hours, reflecting the more specialised, appointment-based nature of clinic services compared with general retail trade.

Based in Waterkloof Glen, the consultancy is positioned within reach of Pretoria's eastern suburbs and business districts, giving local clients access to this combination of risk-management and tax-focused business consulting.

Among the pieces the workshop creates are engraved pendants, birthstone rings and custom-designed heirloom jewellery, each developed in close consultation with the client so that the final design reflects that person's own story rather than a standard, off-the-shelf option. This made-to-order, client-led process distinguishes Eric's Manufacturing Jewellers from retailers that primarily sell pre-made stock, instead positioning the business as a manufacturing jeweller that builds each commission from the ground up.

Operating from Rachel de Beer Street in Pretoria North, the workshop serves customers across the greater Pretoria area who are looking for bespoke jewellery for occasions such as engagements, birthdays, anniversaries or other personally significant milestones.

It describes itself as the first choice printing shop in Centurion, while also servicing clients across the whole of South Africa through email and courier delivery, allowing customers outside the immediate area to place and receive orders without visiting in person.

Espress Print and Brand positions its service as covering the full process from concept development through to the final printed or digital product, aiming to guide clients at every stage rather than simply fulfilling a single print order. Its residential work ranges from smaller homes and garden flats to large mansions, with designs tailored to suit different budgets, while its interior design offerings include showers, kitchen splashbacks and mirrors for spaces such as home gyms. To ensure consistent quality, the business works alongside some of the leading manufacturers and distributors in the glass and aluminium industry, aiming to have every product exceed expectations rather than simply meet a minimum standard.

Evolution AluGlass also describes a deliberate focus on supporting its local community, stating that it hires its staff from the surrounding area as part of an effort to build a stronger, brighter future for local families and the community more broadly. This combination of residential and interior glass and aluminium work, backed by established industry partnerships, positions the business to serve both new-build and renovation projects across Wonderboom South and the wider Pretoria area.

Its stock includes refurbished laptops from brands such as Lenovo, HP and Asus, pre-owned Apple MacBooks, and a range of components, chargers and cables, alongside refurbished and open-box items sold at reduced prices compared with new equivalents. By focusing on pre-owned and refurbished stock rather than only new equipment, eWorkshop offers customers access to higher-specification laptops, desktops and phones at prices below those of equivalent new devices, while refurbished items are tested and prepared for resale before being offered for sale.
